Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 1280 Records detected", "Trading Partners 10", "Ports 9", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-24"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (1 export to USA + 4 imports from China) plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows. So 1280 is the platform's aggregate counter, not the number of rows verifiable here — only 1 export row was directly readable.

note: Real export shipments confirmed by customs bill-of-lading record, not by website claims: BOL 9681217, dated 2026-02-14, Nhava Sheva Sea (INNSA1) -> Boston, USA, HS 40101290, consignee Whitney Son, Inc. The company is simultaneously a substantial importer of Chinese conveyor belt (JM Manufacturing Ltd, Qingdao Global Belting Co. Ltd, Qingdao origin, HS 40101290, BOLs 7723985 / 7427205 / 7222162 / 7215204, dates 2026-01-30 to 2026-02-24), which is consistent with a trader/manufacturer_trader model (import-and-resell plus own belting output) rather than a pure manufacturer — role should be treated as manufacturer_trader or trader, not manufacturer. Declared HS 401012 is correct as filed (observed 40101290), so no HS correction is needed. Domestic (India) supply side is unverified, not absent: absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales. Two other slug variants (dura-conveyor-belting-pvt-ltd, dura-conveyor-belting-private-ltd) returned empty record tables, so the confirmed data rests on the single slug above. Revenue and export volume figures are null — ImportKey free view exposes no values (only a USD-per-meter unit price inside the goods description, which is not a company turnover figure).
